name: doc-handover
description: Compiles a Handover Doc with the state of each workstream, a register of open decisions and risks, key people by role, where things live and the first two weeks for the next owner. Use for "run doc-handover", "handover doc", "I am going on leave", "changing teams", "hand over my workstreams", "I took over mid-way", "what does the next PM need", "transition notes", part of the Claude Docs for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
